PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 3 days (nights≈2). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Petra, Wadi Rum, Aqaba
- Destination→cluster map: Petra→cluster 1 (Ma'an Governorate · history); Wadi Rum→cluster 1 (Ma'an Governorate · history); Aqaba→cluster 2 (Aqaba Governorate · history, culture)
- Day→cluster route: D1:C1/Petra+Wadi Rum → D2:C1/Petra+Wadi Rum → D3:C2/Aqaba
- mustVisit entity lock: Wadi Rum→Red Sand Dunes of Wadi Rum (cluster 1); Petra→Petra Museum (cluster 1)
- Each day uses entities primarily from its mapped cluster (meals/hotels from that cluster).
- Do not invent a parallel trip from random clusters; unused clusters are alternatives only.
- Lodging: rating=5 star, type=hotel. Reuse base hotel(s) across consecutive nights: Cedar Hotel, Petra Aretas Hotel. One hotel per overnight base — do not rotate hotels daily in the same area.
- Selection bias: aiPriority=comfort; SME=(none). Prefer matching why_retrieved/facts among retrieved options.
- Budget target ≈ 800.0 JOD when facts allow.
- Names/hours: EntityCards only. If not in evidence, skip — never invent.
- Prices: use the card value as-is; if missing, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.
